description: All 9 Filament dashboard widgets (School, Administration, Directorate levels) plus the custom Dashboard page and AdminPanelProvider update. Depends on FEAT-001's DashboardStatsService being in place. Independent of FEAT-003 (Reports page).
steps: 1. Create directory structure: mkdir -p app/Filament/Widgets/School app/Filament/Widgets/Administration app/Filament/Widgets/Directorate

2. Create app/Filament/Widgets/School/SchoolStatusOverview.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Widgets\School
   — extends Filament\Widgets\StatsOverviewWidget
   — public static int $sort = 1;
   — canView(): bool — Auth::check() && Auth::user()->organization && Auth::user()->organization->isSchool(). Use Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->find(Auth::user()->organization_id) to avoid OrganizationScope issues.
   — getStats(): array — call app(DashboardStatsService::class)->schoolStatusCounts($org) where $org is the auth user's org loaded without global scopes. Build one Stat per LeaveStatus case using Stat::make(label, count)->color(LeaveStatus->color())->icon(heroicon). Use these heroicons: DRAFT heroicon-o-pencil-square, SUBMITTED heroicon-o-paper-airplane, IN_REVIEW heroicon-o-eye, RETURNED heroicon-o-arrow-uturn-left, APPROVED heroicon-o-check-circle, REJECTED heroicon-o-x-circle, CANCELLED heroicon-o-archive-box-x-mark.

4. Create app/Filament/Widgets/School/PendingRequestsWidget.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Widgets\School
   — extends Filament\Widgets\TableWidget
   — public static int $sort = 3;
   — protected static ?string $heading = 'الطلبات المعلقة';
   — canView(): same school check.
   — getTableQuery(): LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->with(['employee','leaveType'])->whereIn('organization_id',$org->subtreeIds())->whereIn('status',[SUBMITTED,IN_REVIEW])->orderBy('submitted_at').
   — Columns: TextColumn number label 'رقم الطلب', TextColumn employee.full_name label 'اسم الموظف', TextColumn leaveType.name label 'نوع الإجازة', TextColumn submitted_at label 'تاريخ التقديم' ->dateTime()->description(fn($r) => $r->submitted_at && $r->submitted_at < now()->subDays(3) ? 'متأخر' : null)->descriptionColor('danger'), TextColumn days label 'الأيام'.

5. Create app/Filament/Widgets/Administration/SchoolComparisonWidget.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Widgets\Administration
   — extends Filament\Widgets\TableWidget
   — public static int $sort = 4;
   — protected static ?string $heading = 'مقارنة المدارس';
   — canView(): org->isAdministration() || org->isDirectorate().
   — getTableQuery(): returns a query-compatible object. Since administrationSchoolStats returns a Collection of arrays, use a raw Builder or implement using Filament's fromCollection. Best approach: query Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('parent_id',$org->id) joined with aggregated leave_requests sub-query. Alternatively build the Collection and use getTableRecords() override. Use ->fromCollection() if Filament supports it, else use a direct Eloquent query with selectRaw aggregates.
   — Columns: TextColumn name label 'المدرسة', TextColumn total_requests label 'إجمالي الطلبات', TextColumn pending label 'معلق', TextColumn approved label 'معتمد', TextColumn rejected label 'مرفوض', TextColumn rejection_rate label 'نسبة الرفض %'.
   — Implementation note: The cleanest approach is to override protected function getTableRecords(): Collection and return app(DashboardStatsService::class)->administrationSchoolStats($org) as a Collection of stdClass/array-cast objects. For Filament TableWidget this requires setting getTableQuery() to return Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->whereIn('id',[0]) (empty base query) and overriding getTableRecords(). Actually simpler: implement getTableQuery() returning an actual Eloquent Builder with LEFT JOIN aggregates on leave_requests for child schools — use Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('parent_id',$org->id)->withCount(['... (see pattern)']). Since withCount won't do conditional counts easily, use selectRaw with LEFT JOIN on leave_requests filtered by status.

6. Create app/Filament/Widgets/Administration/TopLeaveTakersWidget.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Widgets\Administration
   — extends Filament\Widgets\TableWidget
   — public static int $sort = 5;
   — protected static ?string $heading = 'أكثر الموظفين إجازةً';
   — canView(): isAdministration() || isDirectorate().
   — getTableQuery(): use the raw query from DashboardStatsService::topLeaveTakers as the base. Since the service returns a Collection, implement getTableQuery() as Employee::withoutGlobalScopes()->join('leave_requests','leave_requests.employee_id','employees.id')->join('organizations','organizations.id','employees.organization_id')->whereIn('employees.organization_id',$org->subtreeIds())->where('leave_requests.status',APPROVED)->selectRaw('employees.id, employees.full_name, organizations.name as school_name, SUM(leave_requests.days) as total_days, COUNT(leave_requests.id) as request_count')->groupBy('employees.id','employees.full_name','organizations.name')->orderByDesc('total_days')->limit(10).
   — Columns: TextColumn full_name label 'اسم الموظف', TextColumn school_name label 'المدرسة', TextColumn total_days label 'إجمالي الأيام', TextColumn request_count label 'عدد الطلبات'.

7. Create app/Filament/Widgets/Administration/AvgResponseTimeWidget.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Widgets\Administration
   — extends Filament\Widgets\StatsOverviewWidget
   — public static int $sort = 6;
   — canView(): isAdministration() || isDirectorate().
   — getStats(): call DashboardStatsService. Stat 1: Stat::make('متوسط وقت الاستجابة (ساعة)', number_format($svc->avgResponseTime($org),1))->icon('heroicon-o-clock')->color('info'). Stat 2: Stat::make('نسبة الرفض %', compute rejected/total*100 from counts using a direct query)->icon('heroicon-o-x-circle')->color('danger'). Stat 3: Stat::make('الطلبات المتأخرة', $svc->overdueCount($org))->icon('heroicon-o-exclamation-triangle')->color('warning').

8. Create app/Filament/Widgets/Directorate/MonthlyTrendWidget.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Widgets\Directorate
   — extends Filament\Widgets\ChartWidget
   — public static int $sort = 7;
   — protected static ?string $heading = 'الطلبات الشهرية';
   — canView(): isDirectorate().
   — getType(): 'line'
   — getData(): $data = app(DashboardStatsService::class)->monthlyRequestTrend($org, now()->year); return ['datasets'=>[['label'=>'عدد الطلبات','data'=>array_values($data)]],'labels'=>['يناير','فبراير','مارس','أبريل','مايو','يونيو','يوليو','أغسطس','سبتمبر','أكتوبر','نوفمبر','ديسمبر']].

9. Create app/Filament/Widgets/Directorate/AdministrationComparisonWidget.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Widgets\Directorate
   — extends Filament\Widgets\TableWidget
   — public static int $sort = 8;
   — protected static ?string $heading = 'مقارنة الإدارات';
   — canView(): isDirectorate().
   — getTableQuery(): Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('parent_id',$org->id) with LEFT JOIN aggregates on leave_requests (same approach as SchoolComparisonWidget but for admin children). Use selectRaw with sub-query counts for total_requests, approved_count, pending_count, avg_response_hours.
   — Columns: name label 'الإدارة', total_requests label 'إجمالي', approved_count label 'معتمد', pending_count label 'معلق', avg_response_hours label 'متوسط الاستجابة ساعة'.

10. Create app/Filament/Widgets/Directorate/YearlyComparisonWidget.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Widgets\Directorate
   — extends Filament\Widgets\ChartWidget
   — public static int $sort = 9;
   — protected static ?string $heading = 'المقارنة السنوية';
   — canView(): isDirectorate().
   — getType(): 'bar'
   — getData(): $data = app(DashboardStatsService::class)->yearlyComparison($org, 3); return ['datasets'=>[['label'=>'الطلبات','data'=>array_values($data)]],'labels'=>array_map('strval',array_keys($data))].

11. Create app/Filament/Pages/Dashboard.php.
   — namespace App\Filament\Pages
   — extends Filament\Pages\Dashboard
   — protected static ?string $title = 'لوحة تحكم نظام الإجازات';
   — No other overrides needed — widget discovery handles the rest.

12. Update app/Providers/Filament/AdminPanelProvider.php.
   — In the ->pages([]) array, replace Filament\Pages\Dashboard::class with App\Filament\Pages\Dashboard::class.
   — Add use App\Filament\Pages\Dashboard; import.
   — Add NavigationGroup::make('التقارير')->icon('heroicon-o-chart-bar') to navigationGroups array.
